changes: Added an opt-in wake word in Settings: with audio recording on, say "Omi" and then your question, and Omi answers out loud from the notch and keeps the conversation going for follow-ups
Omi no longer hears its own spoken answers as if you had said them, so a long answer plays to the end and the transcript stays yours
Omi links to conversations, tasks, memories, and lists of them now open straight in the Mac app
